brand.purpose: Serif identity; 24px on mobile and 22px at 380px and below.

title.purpose: Sans-serif photograph filename; 18px on mobile. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

body.purpose: Root editor text. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

section.purpose: Settings legends. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

label.purpose: Field labels. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

caption.purpose: Counts, source dimensions, thumbnails, and preview descriptions. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

hint.purpose: Functional guidance. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

text-action.purpose: Contextual actions such as Apply split to all and Download this slide. Uses the platform system sans-serif stack.

scope.purpose: Independent Apply to all photos checkbox labels.

shadows.name: inspector
shadows.purpose: Very faint desktop pane separation; removed on mobile.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Background changes; borders, shadows, and transforms use .18s ease.

motion.name: photo-settle
motion.purpose: Changed photograph animates from opacity .7 and translateY(3px). Disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable animation, transitions, and smooth scrolling.

motion.name: metadata-controls-in
motion.purpose: Metadata controls enter from opacity .7 and translateY(-3px); disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Add photos
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);border:0;background:none;transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease;}.ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 17px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4cfc4);border-radius:var(--radius,4px);font-weight:500;background:var(--panel,#f6f3ec)}.ds-button.ds-primary{background:var(--ink,#302f2b);color:var(--button-ink,#fffaf4);border-color:var(--ink,#302f2b)}.ds-button.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#47443d}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--hover,#e5e0d5)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}.ds-button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button,.ds-primary{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}} .ds-button.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#47443d}

components.name: Export
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);border:0;background:none;transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease;}.ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:44px;padding:9px 17px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d4cfc4);border-radius:var(--radius,4px);font-weight:500;background:var(--panel,#f6f3ec)}.ds-button.ds-primary{background:var(--ink,#302f2b);color:var(--button-ink,#fffaf4);border-color:var(--ink,#302f2b)}.ds-export{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--accent,#a93f36)!important;border-color:var(--accent,#a93f36)!important}.ds-export:hover:not(:disabled){background:#8c332c!important}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--hover,#e5e0d5)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}.ds-button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button,.ds-primary,.ds-export{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Remove photo
components.html: <button class="ds-trash" aria-label="Remove selected photo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V4h6v3M7 7l1 13h8l1-13M10 10v7m4-7v7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Auto format select
components.description: Per-photo Custom or Instagram resolution profile; batch scope is separate.
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font:500 13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302f2b)}.ds-select{display:block;margin-top:7px;font:14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:9px;background:#fffdf780;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);border:1px solid #d9d3c7;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #302f2b04}.ds-select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px;border-color:var(--accent,#a93f36)}.ds-select:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}

components.name: Metadata text
components.description: Per-photo metadata text, prefilled and directly editable.
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;font:13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302f2b)}.ds-field{display:block;margin-top:7px;font:14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;width:100%;min-height:44px;resize:vertical;background:#fffdf780;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);border:1px solid #d9d3c7;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #302f2b04;padding:9px;caret-color:var(--accent,#a93f36)}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px;border-color:var(--accent,#a93f36)}

components.name: Split segments
components.css: .ds-segments{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line,#d4cfc4);border-radius:var(--radius,4px);padding:3px;gap:2px}.ds-segments button{font-size:12px;min-height:38px;padding:5px 2px;border-radius:2px}.ds-segments button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft,#ecd5c8);color:var(--accent,#a93f36);font-weight:600}.ds-segments button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);cursor:pointer}.ds-segments button:hover{background:var(--hover,#e5e0d5)}.ds-segments button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--accent-soft,#ecd5c8);color:var(--accent,#a93f36)}.ds-segments button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-segments{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}.ds-segments{background:#e9e5dc;border:0;padding:4px;border-radius:8px}.ds-segments button{border-radius:5px}.ds-segments button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fffdf8;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);box-shadow:0 1px 4px #302f2b18}

components.name: Photo navigation
components.description: Photo rail selection with filename and source dimensions.
components.css: .ds-photo{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink,#302f2b);border:0;background:none;transition:background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease;}.ds-photo{padding:5px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:3px;display:block;width:100%;text-align:left}.ds-photo[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:var(--accent,#a93f36);background:var(--accent-soft,#ecd5c8)}.ds-name{display:block;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;margin:7px 1px 0}.ds-detail{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#66645e);margin:1px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-photo:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--hover,#e5e0d5)}.ds-photo:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}.ds-photo:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}.ds-rail{width:122px}.ds-thumb{display:block;height:87px;background:var(--stage,#dedbd1);border-radius:1px}.ds-photo[aria-pressed=true]:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#ecd5c8)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-photo,.ds-name,.ds-detail{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Numeric stepper
components.description: Precise numeric adjustment with direct entry.
components.css: .ds-adjust{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font:13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302f2b)}.ds-stepper{display:flex;align-items:center;background:#fffdf8;border:1px solid #d7d1c4;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:0 1px 3px #302f2b08;overflow:hidden}.ds-stepper button{width:38px;height:40px;border:0;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-stepper input{font:inherit;width:42px;height:36px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;appearance:textfield}.ds-stepper button:hover{background:var(--hover,#e5e0d5)}.ds-stepper button:focus-visible,.ds-stepper input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}.ds-stepper svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

components.name: Quality slider
components.description: JPEG percentage; disabled for lossless PNG.
components.html: <label class="ds-quality">Output quality <output>90%</output><input type="range" min="10" max="100" value="90" /></label>
components.css: .ds-quality{font:13px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#302f2b)}.ds-quality output{float:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted,#66645e)}.ds-quality input{display:block;width:100%;height:32px;appearance:none;background:transparent}.ds-quality input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:4px;background:#d4cec1;border-radius:4px}.ds-quality input::-moz-range-track{height:4px;background:#d4cec1;border-radius:4px}.ds-quality input::-webkit-slider-thumb{appearance:none;width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:-7px;border-radius:50%;background:#fffdf8;border:1px solid #b8b0a0;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #302f2b24}.ds-quality input::-moz-range-thumb{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#fffdf8;border:1px solid #b8b0a0;box-shadow:0 2px 4px #302f2b24}.ds-quality input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}.ds-quality input:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}

components.name: Batch scope checkbox
components.description: Independent scope for the adjacent setting.
components.css: .ds-scope{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;min-height:36px;font:12px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#66645e);cursor:pointer}.ds-scope input{accent-color:var(--accent,#a93f36);width:15px;height:15px;margin:0}.ds-scope input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a93f36);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
The Photography Light Table uses one cream and sand palette, warm gray structure, charcoal text, and restrained coral accents. The identity and empty invitation use Source Serif 4; the editor uses the platform system sans-serif stack, with Source Sans 3 as a fallback.

Quiet panes and compact controls keep photographs central. Exact values use editable numeric steppers; JPEG quality keeps a bounded slider. The final cascade in styles.css and the controls in index.html are normative.
keyCharacteristics: One fixed light palette; no theme switch.
Per-photo settings with independent batch-scope checkboxes.
Soft field edges, restrained shadows, and visible numeric values.
dos: Do preserve the fixed cream, sand, gray, and coral world.
Do use system typography for controls and Source Serif 4 for identity and invitation.
Do show the current value beside decrement and increment actions, with direct numeric entry.
Do keep Auto format and Canvas shape scope independent.
Do keep visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark/light themes, marketing copy, or preloaded photographs.
Don't describe file encoding as a resolution choice; JPG/PNG and Instagram/Custom are independent.
Don't add film counters or barcodes; 35mm is the only film lettering.
Don't add source-mode selectors, metadata field toggles, or custom-note controls.
